cards.review_notes: The undated mission page states summer programming runs 7:30am-5:30pm, but its Hours of Operation section states 8am-5:30pm; start time is therefore null. Ages 5-18 are stated for year-round Club membership rather than separately for summer. No explicitly dated 2026 or 2027 summer schedule was found.
